recognize_zh: 胸腹部臨床照片中有多發、大小不一的深紫褐色斑片與略隆起的斑塊，部分呈圓形或環狀、表面輕度苔蘚化並有細屑，背景皮膚色素不均，符合蕈狀肉芽腫的多發斑塊期皮膚病灶。
features: Clinical photograph of the anterior chest and abdomen
Multiple variably sized dusky violaceous to dark brown patches and slightly raised plaques
Several round to annular lesions with darker borders, including lesions around both nipples and on the abdomen
Background mottled hyperpigmentation with fine scale and mild lichenification
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the anterior trunk shows multiple dusky violaceous-brown patches and thin plaques of varying size, some round to annular with darker borders, on a background of mottled hyperpigmentation with fine scale. No exophytic tumors or ulcers are present. This is a clinical image and is not diagnostic on its own; in a patient with documented blood involvement, the distribution and appearance are compatible with patch/plaque-stage mycosis fungoides.

ddx.vs: Nummular eczema forms coin-shaped, often vesicular or crusted plaques and biopsy shows spongiosis rather than epidermotropism of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes.
Psoriatic plaques are sharply demarcated with thick silvery scale and show psoriasiform hyperplasia with Munro microabscesses.
Tinea shows an active scaly advancing border with central clearing and fungal hyphae on KOH or PAS.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
ddx.vs: ATLL has HTLV-1 positivity and CD25-positive 'flower cells' in blood, which distinguishes it from mycosis fungoides.
